mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% over the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment (UNRATE) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a deepening economic contraction that reduces corporate profitability and investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rise > 0.2pp in 1 month AND INDPRO fall > 0.5 in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and INDPRO falls > 0.5 in 1 month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), the S&P 500 tends to decline over the next 20 trading days as higher discount rates reduce equity valuations and dampen economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (relative to 2017=100) signals a contraction in the real economy that reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1400.0 (thousands of units) signals weak consumer confidence and reduced construction activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when HOUST < 1400.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) of more than 0.5% in a single month signals an unexpected monetary tightening that causes immediate equity market volatility and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5pp in 1 month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) below 690,000 million dollars over the past 3 months signals weakening consumer demand that reduces corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS < 690000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.
